response.sql: WITH signal_telescope AS (SELECT s.signalregistry, s.pulsepersec, t.equipstatus FROM signals s INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate FROM signal_telescope WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_value FROM status_averages), first_filter AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_value as excess_over_first FROM status_averages sa CROSS JOIN first_mean fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_value), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_value FROM first_filter), second_filter AS (SELECT ff.equipstatus, ff.avg_pulse_rate, ff.excess_over_first, ff.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_value as excess_over_second FROM first_filter ff CROSS JOIN second_mean sm WHERE ff.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_value) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as final_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(excess_over_first) as avg_excess_over_first, AVG(excess_over_second) as avg_excess_over_second FROM second_filter;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in signals.pulsepersec should be excluded from average calculations (standard SQL AVG behavior), not treated as zero
signals.telescref properly references telescopes.telescregistry; the INNER JOIN correctly drops any orphaned signals
